title: The Horizon of Light
subtitle: Tarisiro
note: Structure verified against the separated vocal stem (Demucs htdemucs) + MMS_FA + Whisper large-v3. The generated track sings verse 1, then the two Ndebele chorus lines twice, then verse 2. It does not sing the written English chorus lines, the second chorus or the final chorus; 151-230 s is instrumental / vocalise.

lines.text: We breathe the air of a morning unwritten
Where the red soil remembers the strength of the past
Like the mist on the mountains, our spirits awaken
To a future where healing and harmony last

lines.translation: Be still, our land, the sun shines
Our whole land now has peace
Be still, our land, the sun shines
Our whole land now has peace
In the shadow of stars, the strength of our roots
A beautiful nation filled with hope

lines.text: We trace the rivers that run to the sea
Carrying grace for the ages to be
In the quiet of dawn, a new land is born
Guided by truth, by grace, by the light
